### Hexcel Reports 2026 Third Quarter Results


October 21, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/180688177/files/content_files/HXL-Q3-2026-Earnings-Release.pdf)


STAMFORD, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL):


- **Q3 2026 Sales were $496 million, an 8.8% increase compared to Q3 2025 sales of $456 million (9.2% increase in constant currency).**
- **Q3 2026 GAAP diluted EPS of $0.50 compared to Q3 2025 GAAP diluted EPS of $0.26.**
- **Q3 2026 adjusted diluted EPS of $0.50, compared to Q3 2025 adjusted diluted EPS of $0.37.**
- **2026 guidance unchanged.**
- **Share repurchase authorization increased to $750 million.**


**See Table C for reconciliation of GAAP and non-GAAP operating income, net income, earnings per share and operating cash flow to free cash flow. Free cash flow is cash from operations less capital expenditures.**

Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL) today reported third quarter 2026 results including net sales of $496 million and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.50 per share.


Chairman, CEO and President Tom Gentile said, “Consistent with what we communicated last quarter, our third quarter financial results reflected our typical summer sales seasonality, which impacted operating leverage. We also experienced near-term cost headwinds from accelerated hiring and training to support the strong demand signals we are receiving across our business for Q4 and 2027. In terms of market demand, commercial aerospace sales increased 21% year-over-year as the industry recovery continues to take hold, partially offset by temporary softness in a few fighter and space programs that impacted Defense, Space & Other sales. We are reaffirming our 2026 guidance and expect full year results to be within the sales and adjusted EPS ranges previously provided.”


Mr. Gentile continued, “We expect to return to our targeted leverage range by the end of 2026 as we have prioritized debt repayment following the accelerated share repurchase program we initiated last year at this time. Reflecting confidence in the strong cash generation profile of the business, the Board of Directors increased the share repurchase authorization to $750 million from $381 million.”


**Markets**


Sales in the third quarter of 2026 were $496.4 million compared to $456.2 million in the third quarter of 2025.


**Commercial Aerospace**


- Commercial Aerospace sales of $330.3 million for the third quarter of 2026 increased 20.5% (21.0% in constant currency) compared to the third quarter of 2025. Both widebodies, including the Airbus A350 and Boeing 787, and narrowbodies including the Airbus A320 and Boeing MAX grew year over year. Other Commercial Aerospace increased 1.3% for the third quarter of 2026 compared to the third quarter of 2025.


**Defense, Space & Other**


- Defense, Space & Other sales of $166.1 million in the third quarter of 2026 decreased 8.7% (8.6% in constant currency) for the quarter as compared to the third quarter of 2025. The sales decrease primarily reflected the previously disclosed divestment of a non-core Austrian-based industrial business at the end of September, 2025 and the closure of a non-core industrial business in Leicester, UK earlier this year along with temporary softness in F-35 and an international fighter program as well as launchers and rocket motors.


**Consolidated Operations**


Gross margin for the third quarter of 2026 was 23.3% compared to 21.9% in the third quarter of 2025 as higher volume drove operating leverage year over year. As a percentage of sales, selling, general and administrative expenses for the third quarter of 2026 was 9.0% compared to 9.0% for the third quarter of 2025. R&D expenses as a percentage of sales were 3.3% for the third quarter of 2026 compared to 3.1% for the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted operating income in the third quarter of 2026 was $54.4 million or 11.0% of sales, compared to $44.8 million, or 9.8% of sales in 2025. The impact of exchange rates on operating income as a percent of sales was unfavorable by approximately 30 basis points in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the third quarter of 2025.


**Year-to-Date 2026 Results**


Sales for the first nine months of 2026 were $1,527.2 million compared to $1,402.6 million, a 8.9% increase from the same period in 2025.


**Commercial Aerospace (66% of YTD sales)**


- Commercial Aerospace sales of $1,009.6 million increased 19.1% (19.6% in constant currency) for the first nine months of 2026 compared to the first nine months of 2025, with growth led by the A350, 787 and MAX platforms. Other Commercial Aerospace increased 6.4% for the first nine months of 2026 compared to the same period in 2025 from higher regional jet sales.


**Defense, Space & Other (34% of YTD sales)**


- Defense, Space & Other sales of $517.6 million decreased 6.8% (7.7% in constant currency) for the first nine months of 2026 as compared to the first nine months of 2025. The sales decrease primarily reflected the previously disclosed divestment of a non-core Austrian-based industrial business and the closure of a non-core industrial business in Leicester, UK along with lower launcher and rocket motor sales.


**Consolidated Operations**


Gross margin for the first nine months of 2026 was 25.4% compared to 22.4% in the prior year period as the current period benefited from higher sales leverage. As a percentage of sales, selling, general and administrative for the first nine months of 2026 was 9.3% compared to 9.1% for the first nine months of 2025. R&D expenses as a percentage of sales for the first nine months of 2026 was 3.4% compared to 3.0% for the first nine months of 2025. Adjusted operating income for the first nine months of 2026 was $195.5 million or 12.8% of sales, compared to $144.3 million or 10.3% of sales in 2025. The impact of exchange rates on operating income as a percent of sales was unfavorable by approximately 70 basis points in the first nine months of 2026 compared to the first nine months of 2025. Other operating expense for the first nine months of 2026 included restructuring expenses related to the shutdown of industrial-oriented manufacturing at the Leicester, UK facility and non-recurring professional fees. Other operating expense for the first nine months of 2025 primarily reflected charges for the divestiture of the Neumarkt, Austria business, closure of the Welkenraedt, Belgium facility and divestiture of the Hartford, Connecticut business.


**Cash and other**


- Net cash provided by operating activities in the first nine months of 2026 was $171.1 million, compared to $105.0 million for the first nine months of 2025. Working capital was a cash use of $78.1 million for the first nine months of 2026 and a use of $63.8 million for the comparable period in 2025. Capital expenditures on a cash basis were $68.6 million for the first nine months of 2026 compared to $55.1 million for the same period in 2025. Free cash flow was $102.5 million in the first nine months of 2026 compared to $49.9 million in the first nine months of 2025. Free cash flow is defined as cash generated from operating activities less cash paid for capital expenditures. Capital expenditures on an accrual basis were $61.2 million and $49.9 million for the first nine months of 2026 and 2025, respectively.
- During the third quarter of 2026, the Company did not repurchase any shares. As of September 30, 2026, the aggregate remaining authorization under the share repurchase program was approximately $380.6 million. Today, the Board of Directors authorized an increase to the share repurchase program, raising the total authorization to $750.0 million.
- As announced today, the Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.18 per share payable to stockholders of record as of November 2, 2026, with a payment date of November 9, 2026.


**2026 Guidance (unchanged)**


- Sales of $2.025 billion to $2.125 billion
- Adjusted diluted earnings per share of $2.30 to $2.40
- Free cash flow of greater than $195 million
- Capital expenditures less than $100 million

**About Hexcel**


[Hexcel Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.hexcel.com%2F&esheet=54626386&newsitemid=20261021238404&lan=en-US&anchor=Hexcel+Corporation&index=2&md5=da0a7329b8eeb88e8dda2cd896199c33) is a global leader in advanced lightweight composites technology. We provide innovative, high-performance material solutions that are lighter, stronger, and tougher, shaping a world that moves farther, smarter, and more efficiently. Our broad and unrivaled product range includes carbon fiber, specialty reinforcements, prepregs and other fiber-reinforced matrix materials, honeycomb, resins, engineered core, and composite structures for use in commercial aerospace, defense and space, and industrial applications.
